properties.evidence: Its own description scopes the owner's-word rule to the typed doors: "add_decision and add_requirement accept optional status + approver", "set_decision_status and set_requirement_status take the same two fields", "add_design_rule accepts approver beside enforced". Neither it, nor #628's settles table (one row per TOOL), ever reached a writer whose status arrives inside a generic property bag or a whole document. So create_node, create_nodes, import_graph and apply_merge have no approver parameter and no gate.
